reuse_audit.status: source-present candidates; no type compatibility or new compiled theorem claimed
reuse_audit.rule: Inspect types and transitive imports at the pinned toolchain. Reuse exact matches; adapt near matches; missing multi-consumer result becomes one route=shared Frontier Cell. No second graph/PMF library.

exact_local_candidates.role: State-neutral Markov kernel algebra; continuity, concrete process construction and generator domain are not assumed.
Generic -integral f Lg. A reversible finite-sum identity is the adapter to prove, not a new definition.
Var <= C E convention; discrete spectral-gap lambda adapter uses C=1/lambda.
Density entropy <= (C/2) E(r,log r); jump MLSI alpha convention corresponds to alpha=2/C after admissibility/clock alignment. Do not rename or duplicate on terminology alone.

separations: Discrete state space does not mean discrete time. Poissonization is not Euler discretization.
One update, one sweep, L=P-I, and n(P-I) change rate constants.
PI, ordinary LSI, modified LSI, and one-step entropy contraction are different claims.
Spectral independence is uniform over feasible pinnings, not merely an unconditioned Hessian bound.
A bottleneck for a specified Glauber kernel is not a SampleWiki all-oracle lower bound.
Discrete Maas transport is not standard W2 on a finite metric space.
